title: SSE event envelope
description: Envelope shape only (id/event/data/retry per the SSE spec) — exact `event` names are finalized once the graph's nodes exist to emit them; `event` stays an open string enum until then, not invented ahead of the nodes it names.

id.description: Monotonic per-session event id, for client reconnect/Last-Event-ID.

event.description: Node/state name this event reports — enumerated once the graph's nodes exist (step names: read, diagnose, plan, consent, write, readback, receipt).

data.description: Node-specific typed payload; shape finalized per event name once the graph exists.

retry.description: Client reconnect delay in milliseconds, per the SSE spec.
